title.rendered: Copper voltage stabilizers

content.rendered:
Copper voltage stabilizers

Controls power surges and dips

Ensuring a stable power supply is critical for any industry. Power surges and dips can cause equipment failures, reduce operating efficiency and increase maintenance costs. One of the many solutions is voltage regulation using copper. This is undoubtedly the most effective, since it is a material that stands out for its conductivity, resistance and ability to minimize energy losses. Therefore, voltage stabilizers are more than effective.

Our copper voltage stabilizers are designed to ensure safety, efficiency and durability in the electrical systems of large infrastructures. Thanks to the use of high quality materials, we offer devices capable of maintaining a constant flow of energy, protecting industrial equipment, precision machinery and distribution networks.

What is a copper voltage stabilizer and what is its function?

A voltage stabilizer is an electrical device designed to maintain a stable and constant voltage level in a circuit, regardless of variations in the power supply or connected load. Its main function is to protect electrical and electronic equipment from voltage surges and dips that can cause failures, overheating or even irreparable damage.

They are essential in multiple industrial, commercial and residential applications, as they ensure a reliable and safe power supply. In sectors such as automation, telecommunications, electromedicine and manufacturing, where voltage accuracy is crucial, voltage regulators enable optimal operation of equipment and avoid interruptions in production processes.
Some operate automatically, adjusting the voltage in real time according to the needs of the system, while others allow manual regulation according to user requirements. Their implementation not only extends the service life of connected devices, but also improves energy efficiency and reduces the risk of failures in the electrical infrastructure.

What makes our voltage stabilizers special?

Industries need solutions that guarantee energy stability without interruptions. Our copper voltage regulators reduce equipment wear, optimize energy consumption and lower operating costs.

Greater electrical stability: you will avoid voltage surges and dips that can affect the company’s operations.
Maintenance savings: extends the useful life of electrical equipment and reduces costs due to breakdowns.
Energy efficiency: optimizes consumption, reducing losses and improving network performance.
Reliable technology: products designed with the highest quality standards.

In addition, each voltage regulator guarantees stable power distribution, protecting sensitive machinery, avoiding overloads and ensuring that your company’s operations are not affected by voltage variations. By optimizing power consumption, they contribute to a more efficient use of energy, reducing environmental impact and helping to comply with sustainability regulations.

Torivac is a company specialized in the design and manufacture of toroidal transformers and voltage regulators.

We have nearly 60 years of experience in the industry, which has allowed us to grow to a presence in more than 30 countries.
We have a technical team that guarantees the manufacture of high precision and efficient devices. Our work methodology allows us to perform advanced simulations in each phase of each project, ensuring that each component, from toroidal voltage variators, adjustable transformers, battery dischargers, potentiometers and toroidal cores, meet the highest standards in the industry.
We work closely with companies that have a large infrastructure, seeking to ensure customized and efficient solutions. We aim to respond to the demands of industries such as technology, energy and automotive. Our goal is to continue innovating, strengthening strategic alliances and expanding our global reach, always maintaining the seal of quality and excellence that has characterized us since our beginnings.

content.rendered:
Voltage stabilizers ensure stable supply and cost reduction

Power consumption in large infrastructures directly impacts the profitability and operational efficiency of any industry. Constant power surges and dips not only lead to equipment failures, but also increase electrical expenditure and maintenance costs. To avoid these problems, high-performance voltage stabilizers are vital to ensure stable and optimized power flow.
They ensure the continuity of power supply and the protection of industrial and commercial infrastructure. Our voltage stabilizers maintain a constant energy distribution, avoiding overloads and prolonging the life of the equipment.

What is a voltage stabilizer and what is its function?

A voltage stabilizer is a device designed to maintain a constant voltage level in an electrical system, compensating for variations in the supply network that could affect the operation of connected equipment. Its main function is to protect electrical and electronic devices from voltage surges and dips, preventing damage from surges or voltage drops that can cause failures, reduced performance or even irreparable breakdowns.

These devices are essential in applications where voltage stability is critical, such as in hospitals, data centers, laboratories, manufacturing industries and telecommunications systems. By ensuring a stable power supply, voltage stabilizers optimize equipment performance and extend equipment life.

What is the difference between a voltage protector and a voltage stabilizer?

The voltage stabilizer is equipped with a transformer that has several outputs. This allows it to modify the voltage output to different levels, depending on the needs of the moment. Thus, when the input voltage varies outside normal ranges, the stabilizer does not simply disconnect devices, but actively adjusts the voltage. In doing so, it ensures that your equipment always receives the exact amount of power it needs, no more and no less.

Unlike the stabilizer, which continuously adjusts the voltage, the voltage protector kicks in when it detects an overvoltage (or undervoltage) that exceeds a safe threshold. At that critical instant, it acts quickly to block the excessive energy. You can think of it as a fast and sensitive switch, capable of disconnecting power to protect your equipment in milliseconds.

Why choose a voltage stabilizer?

A voltage stabilizer will not disconnect your device while in use, but will maintain a constant voltage level over time. For example, if your area experiences frequent power surges and dips, a voltage stabilizer would be the right choice, as it keeps the power output stable.

In addition, it contributes to infrastructure protection, reduces costs, improves energy efficiency and ensures operational continuity without risk or interruption.

How does it benefit large energy infrastructures?

Voltage stabilizers play a key role in reducing energy consumption by optimizing the use of electricity and minimizing unnecessary losses. One of the main problems in industrial environments is voltage instability, which can lead to excessive energy consumption and affect equipment performance. These devices ensure that the voltage supplied to machinery is maintained within optimum levels, avoiding overconsumption caused by electrical fluctuations.

Implementing voltage regulators helps to comply with energy regulations and improve the energy efficiency rating of facilities. By consuming only the energy needed for each process, companies can reduce operating costs, improve productivity and contribute to a more sustainable and environmentally responsible industrial model.

We work closely with companies that have a large infrastructure, seeking to guarantee customized and efficient solutions. title.rendered: Torivac battery dischargers

content.rendered:
Torivac battery dischargers

The performance of any electronic device depends on efficient power management. From electric scooters to industrial systems, batteries must discharge their energy in a controlled manner to avoid failure and extend their service life. We design and develop battery dischargers with advanced technology, guaranteeing protection, stability and optimum performance in every application.
These voltage systems are key for companies that market, distribute or use electrical equipment, as they optimize energy consumption, avoid overloads and protect the internal circuits of the devices.
In smart grids, data centers, renewable plants and energy storage systems, the use of battery dischargers is essential to guarantee supply stability, extend the useful life of equipment and optimize the performance of the electrical system. It is essential to know the real capacity of the batteries. A discharger makes it possible to assess their condition and detect possible failures before they affect the power supply.

What is a battery discharger and what is its function?

The battery dischargers we manufacture at Torivac are key tools in the electrical and electronic world. They are used to simulate loads on voltage stabilizers, transformers and other electrical systems, helping to verify how they respond under different conditions. Their main purpose is to provide a controlled load to evaluate the performance of a power source. With them you will reduce the charge level of a battery to a specific voltage or current, allowing you to evaluate its performance, prolong its useful life and avoid problems associated with overcharging or premature aging.
They are used in battery life cycle processes, helping to detect failures before they affect the operation of the systems. In industrial and energy applications, dischargers allow optimizing battery performance, ensuring a reliable energy supply and reducing operating costs.

Testing and preventive maintenance to avoid electrical failures

Battery dischargers allow the capacity and resistance of a power source to be evaluated before problems occur.

Load simulation: allows to verify the performance of an electrical system before its implementation. Ideal for companies wishing to test new energy infrastructures.

Capacity evaluation: helps to determine if a battery can withstand a specific load, ensuring its correct operation.

Preventive maintenance: facilitates early detection of electrical problems, reducing downtime and repair costs.

Power supply stability is a determining factor in the performance of any technological equipment. Voltage variations can affect the efficiency of a device, causing malfunctions or reducing its useful life.

Investing in them not only improves daily operations, but also strengthens competitiveness in the market. Electrical stability is a key factor in ensuring customer satisfaction, product reliability and the reduction of unforeseen events that may affect production or distribution.

In what type of industries are they most commonly used?

Torivac’s battery dischargers have applications in a wide variety of industries. Such as energy, these devices are essential in power generation and distribution plants, where they are used to maintain and test backup batteries in substations and emergency systems. In the telecommunications sector, dischargers are used to assess the condition of batteries used in transmission towers and data centers, ensuring uninterrupted operation in the event of power outages.

Another field of application is the transportation industry, especially in the maintenance of electric vehicles, trains and aircraft, where the performance of batteries needs to be monitored to optimize their autonomy and extend their service life. They are also widely used in the industrial and manufacturing sector, where our devices protect critical machinery and processes against power failures.

What are the most common uses of battery dischargers?

One of the most common uses is in automotive and motorcycle batteries, as a discharger allows to assess their condition and avoid performance problems. They are also useful in bicycles and electric scooters, increasingly popular devices, where it is important to maintain a balanced discharge to prolong battery life.

In homes with solar power systems with storage batteries, a discharger will help manage battery performance, preventing overcharging and ensuring efficient use of stored energy. They can also be applied in uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, which protect equipment such as computers, routers and home servers from power outages.

Torivac is a company specialized in the design and manufacture of toroidal transformers and voltage regulators.

We have nearly 60 years of experience in the industry, which has allowed us to grow to a presence in more than 30 countries.
We have a technical team that guarantees the manufacture of high precision and efficient devices. Our work methodology allows us to perform advanced simulations in each phase of each project, ensuring that each component, from toroidal voltage variators, adjustable transformers, battery dischargers, potentiometers and toroidal cores, meet the highest standards in the industry.
We work closely with companies that have a large infrastructure, seeking to ensure customized and efficient solutions. We aim to respond to the demands of industries such as technology, energy and automotive. Our goal is to continue innovating, strengthening strategic alliances and expanding our global reach, always maintaining the seal of quality and excellence that has characterized us since our beginnings.

title.rendered: What is a Voltage Variator?

content.rendered:
What is a Voltage Variator?

At Torivac, we are experts in all types of electronic elements and components, and today we want to talk to you about one of the most common devices in this sector: the voltage variator. Variable autotransformers, commonly known as voltage variators, allow you to modulate the amplitude of the input sine wave, enabling continuous voltage variation without changing the input frequency and with virtually zero harmonic distortion.

Types of Voltage Regulators

Voltage regulators can come in three different forms:

  • Voltage variators without mechanical protection (IP00): These are mainly intended for industrial environments where the user integrates the variator into their system.
  • Enclosed variators: These are suitable for domestic use or in industrial environments ready for use without prior installation.
  • Turnkey projects: Our engineering team combines voltage variators or variable autotransformers with other components like transformers, load banks, rectifiers, control drivers, or other elements, providing tailored solutions for each customer.

How to Calculate the Power You Need for Your Voltage Variator or Adjustable Autotransformer

An adjustable autotransformer consists of a single, orderly winding, with a cursor moving along it to select the desired voltage.

The relationship between the magnetic section of the core and the wire diameter in voltage variators is crucial in calculating optimal performance, preventing overheating, and maintaining a competitive price.

In variable autotransformers, we must define the maximum operating current in continuous operation and the maximum regulation voltage. Based on these two parameters, we can determine the required power, the magnetic core section, and the winding conductor diameter.

Once these parameters are defined, the appropriate voltage variator format can be chosen for continuous operation, 100% load, 24/7.

When selecting the power of variable autotransformers, it is important to consider that when a variator is installed in an enclosure or cabinet, the ventilation must match the heat dissipation, or the variator windings should be oversized to operate at a lower thermal load.

If you’re not sure whether this component would help meet your needs, don’t worry! We are at your full disposal. Ask us, and we’ll be happy to assist you!

title.rendered: The importance of the toroidal transformer in industry

content.rendered:
The importance of the toroidal transformer in industry

Maximize performance and reduce operating costs with our high-efficiency transformers.

At Torivac we specialize in offering high quality industrial transformers, both toroidal and conventional transformers, custom designed to meet the specific needs of our customers.

These products stand out for their energy efficiency, durability and reliability, with the confidence that comes from a company with more than 60 years of experience. This equipment reduces operating costs and improves the stability of the electrical systems of any business. Our strength for the design of these transformers? We use advanced technology, such as 3D modeling, to ensure high quality and precision products.

In addition, our transformers contribute to environmental sustainability by minimizing energy consumption and carbon footprint. We have a strong commitment and vocation for continuous innovation to offer advanced solutions that exceed our customers’ expectations, without neglecting the ecological aspect.

Which is the most suitable toroidal transformer for your company?

Expert advice is important for an informed and efficient choice. However, there are a number of key considerations that will always help you choose the perfect equipment.

To choose the right toroidal transformer for your company, it is essential to consider aspects such as power requirements, load capacity, quality and energy efficiency, compatibility with electrical equipment, design and installation, as well as to review the relevant technical specifications.

Of course, feel free to consult any questions with electrical experts or electrical engineers can provide personalized guidance. Our team can help you with this. In this way, we guarantee an informed and optimal selection of the transformer that meets your company’s specific energy needs.

Difference between toroidal and conventional transformers: efficiency, design and applications

Unpacking the relationship between cost, efficiency and performance to meet specific energy requirements.

Toroidal and conventional transformers, although both are valid, differ in design and efficiency. Toroidal transformers, fortunately for your company, have a circular core that minimizes losses and noise generation, being more compact and efficient, but they are usually more expensive.

On the other hand, conventional ones, with square or rectangular cores, are more economical but less efficient and can generate more vibrations.

Both perform the same electrical transformation function, but are preferred in different applications depending on space, noise and final cost requirements.
